extracted.name: Summer Tomato Casserole
extracted.description: This tasty tomato casserole is a welcome side dish at your summer table, with fresh vine-ripened tomato slices baked with shredded Cheddar cheese.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place a layer of tomato slices in an 8-inch square baking pan. Spread with a thin layer of mayonnaise and sprinkle with about 1/4 of the Cheddar cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Repeat layers, ending with the remaining Cheddar.
Bake in the preheated oven until tomatoes are softened and cheese is melted and bubbly, 20 to 25 minutes.
